summary.text: Raelyn Light, a Green Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. House in Michigan's 13th District to Donavan McKinney.
Light advanced from the party's July 18, 2026 convention, and little biographical information is available in public sources.
Raelyn Light received 0.6% of the vote to Donavan McKinney's 76.5%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.

sources.title: United States House of Representatives elections in Michigan, 2026
